objectives.title: Inbound Switching Information
objectives.description: The documentation contains information regarding switching and porting to the provider, including known restrictions and technical limitations.
criteria: Information on available switching and porting methods.
Information on available switching and porting formats.
Information on restrictions known to the provider that affect switching and porting.
Information on technical limitations known to the provider that affect switching and porting.

objectives.title: Exportable Data Online Register
objectives.description: The documentation references an online register detailing data export specifications.
criteria: A reference to a provider-hosted online register.
A requirement that the online register remains up-to-date.
Details of available data structures for exportable data.
Details of available data formats for exportable data.
Details of relevant standards for exportable data.
Details of relevant open interoperability specifications for exportable data.
